# Actual pinned 9135253 daemon: discovery is absent, legacy work still executes.
# New placement fields are ignored by its Plan; the CLI must fence submission.
server start
legacy targets list
stdout 'local +local'
! stderr .
taskfile task.json marker
! skygo --json info --target local --require finite-jobs-v1
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
calls /skygo.v1.ControlService/GetServerInfo 1
calls /skygo.v1.ControlService/SubmitJob 0
! exists marker
legacy jobs list
stdout '^ID +TARGET +STATE\n$'
! stderr .

# The old Plan ignores selectors and target labels. Each current command must
# reach missing discovery, produce no success output and never submit work.
! skygo --json plan -f selector.yaml
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
! skygo --json run -f selector.yaml --request-id refused-selector
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
! skygo --json plan -f labels.yaml
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
! skygo --json run -f labels.yaml --request-id refused-labels
stderr 'unimplemented: server does not support capability discovery'
! stdout .
calls /skygo.v1.ControlService/PlanTask 4
calls /skygo.v1.ControlService/GetServerInfo 5
calls /skygo.v1.ControlService/SubmitJob 0
! exists marker
legacy --json jobs list
! stdout '"id"'
! stderr .
legacy jobs list
stdout '^ID +TARGET +STATE\n$'
! stderr .

# Authentication failure at the same old daemon must not be called legacy discovery.
env SKYGO_TOKEN=
! skygo --token wrong info --target local --require finite-jobs-v1
stderr 'unauthenticated'
! stderr 'legacy task commands'
! stdout .
env SKYGO_TOKEN=coverage-token

# Positive control: current default run uses the explicit legacy-compatible path.
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id legacy-default --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
job-id JOB
exists marker
grep '^executed$' marker
calls /skygo.v1.ControlService/SubmitJob 1
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id legacy-default --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^legacy-compatible workload\n$'
server stop
! stderr .

argv: [unused]
node_selector: {zone: west}
-- labels.yaml --
